title: [挑戦しよう] 直近の注文が前回より増えた顧客
statement:
customers と orders から、直近の注文金額がその1つ前の注文金額より大きい顧客を表示してください。出力する列は customer_name, latest_total, previous_total です。

注文が1件しかない顧客は対象外です。直近の注文は ordered_at が最も新しい注文とします。customer_name の昇順で並べます。

constraints.name: 直近と前回
constraints.value: 注文日で並べて、顧客ごとの1番目と2番目の注文を比較します

constraints.name: 対象
constraints.value: 直近の注文金額が前回より大きい顧客だけを残します

starterSql:
WITH ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    total,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY customer_id
      ORDER BY ordered_at DESC, id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM orders
), latest_pairs AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id
    -- 直近と前回の total を取り出します
  FROM ranked_orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT
  customers.name AS customer_name,
  latest_pairs.latest_total,
  latest_pairs.previous_total
FROM latest_pairs
JOIN customers
  ON customers.id = latest_pairs.customer_id
WHERE latest_pairs.latest_total > latest_pairs.previous_total
ORDER BY customers.name ASC;
solutionSql:
WITH ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    total,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY customer_id
      ORDER BY ordered_at DESC, id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM orders
), latest_pairs AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN total END) AS latest_total,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN total END) AS previous_total
  FROM ranked_orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT
  customers.name AS customer_name,
  latest_pairs.latest_total,
  latest_pairs.previous_total
FROM latest_pairs
JOIN customers
  ON customers.id = latest_pairs.customer_id
WHERE latest_pairs.previous_total IS NOT NULL
  AND latest_pairs.latest_total > latest_pairs.previous_total
ORDER BY customers.name ASC;
